project.name: microservices-demo
project.description: Online Boutique: a cloud-first microservices demo that communicates over gRPC.

nodes.name: Frontend Service
nodes.summary: Go web frontend serving the Online Boutique UI and calling backend services over gRPC.

nodes.name: Cart Service
nodes.summary: Stores shopping cart items in Redis.

nodes.name: Product Catalog Service
nodes.summary: Serves product listings from a JSON catalog.

nodes.name: Checkout Service
nodes.summary: Orchestrates cart, shipping, payment, and email to place an order.

nodes.name: Payment Service
nodes.summary: Charges a credit card and returns a transaction id.

nodes.name: Shipping Service
nodes.summary: Quotes shipping cost and ships an order.

nodes.name: Redis Cache
nodes.summary: In-memory store backing the cart service.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Frontend entry point: initializes gRPC clients and starts the HTTP server.

edges.description: Adds and reads cart items via gRPC.
Lists and looks up products via gRPC.
Reads and empties the cart during checkout.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point
tour.description: main.go initializes gRPC connections to all backend services and starts the HTTP server.
tour.languageLesson: Go's main() serves as the application entry point.
